cards.title: terraform_remote_state references
items: 03-platform reads from both the network and cluster states
Only declared outputs cross a layer boundary, which keeps the contract explicit

cards.title: Keeping the contract stable
items: Treat outputs as a public API: renaming one breaks every downstream layer
Prefer passing IDs and ARNs over passing whole objects
Add a new output rather than changing the meaning of an existing one

cards.title: Apply order
items: Destroy in reverse order, or the dependent layers lose their inputs mid-plan
A layer whose upstream state is missing fails at plan time, not apply time
